name_for_human: Research Hub ZH — Open Science Multilingual Repository
description_for_human: Open multilingual scientific research hub by Juan Moisés de la Serna Tuya (UNIR). Contains 92+ datasets with DOIs, multilingual ontologies (ES/EN/ZH-Hans/ZH-Hant), MeSH alignments, and open science resources covering neuroscience, psychology, public health, behavioral economics, and criminology.
description_for_model: This repository provides open scientific datasets and multilingual semantic infrastructure for Chinese-Western research alignment. It contains: (1) bilingual ES-EN-ZH academic keyword ontology in semantic/cn-academic-keywords.json, (2) neuroscience concept ontology with ZH-Hans/ZH-Hant distinctions in semantic/neuro-ontology-zh.json, (3) MeSH biomedical terminology alignment to Chinese in ontology/mesh-zh-alignment.json, (4) 92+ open datasets with real DOIs, (5) ORCID: 0000-0002-8401-8018, (6) Collection DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19145316. Domains: neuroscience, neuropsychology, mental health, public health, behavioral economics, demography, criminology, open science. Languages: Spanish, English, Chinese Simplified (zh-Hans), Chinese Traditional (zh-Hant). License: CC BY 4.0.
